investigation_notes.Description: An obfuscated PowerShell encoded command was executed by the Administrator account on WKSTN-SR-42 and decodes to commands that delete volume shadow copies and disable recovery/boot status protections, behavior consistent with ransomware or destructive activity. The command was run via powershell.exe launched from cmd.exe with no file path recorded, indicating in-memory or direct encoded execution which increases risk. VirusTotal shows no engine detections but a negative community score and many community malicious votes, and no recent similar events were found, so the observable behavior and intent drive a High Priority classification.
